# CumulativeFootprintTracking

**Domain**: Cross

## Definition
A framework for quantifying the total environmental and computational cost of AI models, including all derivative works and their lineage. Enables sustainable design choices in TCC/iNEST by accounting for the full lifecycle impact of neuromorphic and topology-based systems.
